name: hold-up-mints
of: A mechanism by which, during an ongoing process, a previously replaceable party becomes indispensable to its completion, named with the dependency created, the moment substitution stops working, which is the point past which no substitute can finish inside what remains of the process's time, money, or standing, and what extinguishes the resulting power, and sorted by who mints the pivotality: the incumbent with its own hands, head, or custody, the work's own phases, the dependent party's own paper and history, the other parties' signing, conditioning, and leaving, the clock and the schedule with no hand at all, the counterparty's head, a watcher who reads switches, a rule that mints the power and binds it in one motion, or nobody, so that the pivotality is known only when it fails.
items: Poured foundation: the party that did the first phase becomes the only one who can answer for the whole, as the contractor whose foundation is in the ground and the vendor whose first release runs in production, since a replacement can do the next phase but will not warrant what lies under it, and an owner with two parties each warranting half has a defect nobody owns; the dependency created is a single answerable name over work that can no longer be inspected from outside; substitution stops working when the next phase covers the first, because from then on the only record of the buried phase is the incumbent's own sign-off, and it stops for good when re-opening what is buried costs more than what remains of the job; extinguished by a third party's inspection at every phase boundary, bought before the first phase begins so that the record of what lies under the next phase belongs to the owner and a second contractor can accept the seam, or by completion; not who-can-be-bound's Keep the car, where the worker holds the thing until paid, since here the incumbent holds nothing and is pivotal because nobody else will sign for what it did.

Learned your dialect: the incumbent's skill at this customer's particular work is made by the work itself and can be neither written down nor bought elsewhere, as the supplier whose line runs the part at ninety-eight percent yield after a year while a second source would start at sixty, the paralegal who knows this judge's clerk, the nurse who knows this patient's veins; the dependency created is a yield that exists only in the incumbent; substitution stops working when a substitute's ramp, the scrap and the months at low yield, costs more than what remains of the contract, so the same incumbent is replaceable in year one of a five-year contract and pivotal in year four; extinguished by a second source qualified with a real share of the volume while the first still runs, a tax paid throughout as the price of the pivotality never being minted, or by a design change that sets everyone's yield to zero at once; not Head as the only copy, whose state could be written down and has not been, since here no write-down exists and the extinguisher is a second ramp rather than a document; adjacent to lead-time-floors' Ramp inside the floor, which is the replacement's ramp read as a lead time, since here the ramp the incumbent has already run is what mints it.

Head as the only copy: the process writes its state into one participant faster than it writes it down, as the engineer who knows why the configuration is the way it is, the case manager who has met every witness, the arbitrator who has heard the evidence and watched the witnesses' faces, so the record of the process lives in a head and a substitute cannot resume, only restart; the dependency created is unrecorded state; substitution stops working when the gap between what the head knows and what the file says exceeds what a replacement could recover in the time the process has left, which is why an arbitrator can be replaced after a week of hearings and not after a year, and why most institutional rules let the reconstituted tribunal decide whether the hearings must be repeated; extinguished by the write-down, the handover file, the second engineer who must be able to run it alone for a week, which the pivot resists in proportion to the power it would lose, or by completion; adjacent to status-conversions' Immunity by entanglement, where seniority becomes immunity because the institution's memory runs through one person, since that item reads the conversion of standing and this one the date on the calendar after which the person could no longer be replaced; and adjacent to market-deaths' Wall in one head, where a market's comparison wall is one broker's memory, since here the head sits inside a process still running and can still be copied out.

Held on their floor: the only copy of a thing the process cannot continue without sits on the replaceable party's premises, as the customer's mould in the supplier's shop, the master tape at the studio, the reference strain in one laboratory's freezer, the source code on the vendor's servers, so the party is pivotal by custody and not by skill; the dependency created is access to an artefact with no second copy; substitution stops working when re-making the artefact would take longer than the process has left, a mould re-cut in months against a launch in weeks, and stops for good where nothing can re-make it, the strain, the negative, the original; extinguished by a duplicate held elsewhere before the dependence forms, the source-code escrow, the culture deposited in a public collection, the tooling clause that names the owner and the right to collect with a truck and a bailiff, and the clause is worth nothing without the truck; not who-can-be-bound's Keep the car, a lien that makes the customer pay the bill, since the mould's holder does not want to be paid for the mould but for every run after it; and not lead-time-floors' Longest-lead part, the slowest component in a build, since here the component exists and is in the wrong hands.

Past V1: the process enters a phase that cannot be held still while a replacement arrives, so whoever is on the controls at that instant, together with anyone already following the live state beside them, are the only parties who can finish, as the captain past the takeoff decision speed, the anaesthetist after induction, the crane operator with the load off the deck, the tug master inside the lock, the negotiator on the line with the man holding the hostages, the founder in the closing week whose every counterparty has one number in one head; the dependency created is continuity of a state nobody outside the loop can take up in motion; substitution stops working at the instant the phase begins, which is usually a named line, V1, the first incision, the load leaving the deck, and works again at the next stable state, the aircraft at altitude on the autopilot, the patient closed, the load on the ground; extinguished by that next stable state, by a second already in the loop who can take the controls inside the phase, which is what the co-pilot's incapacitation drill, the relief anaesthetist in the room, and the negotiator's second listening on the line are for, by a protocol that makes stable states frequent and the handover at each rehearsed, which is what the shift handover in intensive care and the negotiating team's rota are for, or by the process ending; distinct from lead-time-floors' Understudy, a spare finished and waiting, since a spare that has not been following the state is no use inside the phase, and this map's question is at which instants, and by whom, the spare can be swapped in.

Named in the file: the process's papers name a specific party where any party would have done, and changing the name needs an approval whose lead time is longer than the process has left, as the manufacturing site named in a drug's marketing authorization, the engineer of record whose stamp is on every drawing, the qualified person who releases each batch, the signatory on the bank mandate; the dependency created is a name in a file a third party keeps; substitution stops working when the third party's change procedure, a variation to the authorization, a new engineer's re-review of every sheet, a board resolution and the bank's six weeks, takes longer than the process has left, so the same name is replaceable in the design phase and pivotal in the month before launch; extinguished by the process ending, by a change pre-approved at entry, a second site already named, two signatories on the mandate, or by the third party's own emergency procedure; not who-can-be-bound's Rented door, where a party buys a place at which to be found, since here the party is written into someone else's process and cannot be written out at that process's own speed; not Switch that reads as a tell, where the auditor's name in the prospectus can be changed at will and what binds is that the change must be disclosed, since here the change itself waits on the file's keeper; and the party is pivotal without having done anything but be named.

Consent that wakes at the exit: a consent right written into a routine contract sleeps for the life of the contract and wakes when the dependent party tries to sell, assign, or refinance, so a counterparty that was one customer among many becomes pivotal to the exit, as the customer whose anti-assignment clause is now on the buyer's list of required consents, the landlord whose lease needs consent to a change of control, the lender whose facility has a change-of-control put, the licensor whose licence does not travel; the dependency created is a veto the pivot did not know it held, since the clause was boilerplate at signing and the pivot learns of its power from the consent request; substitution stops working when the exit process starts, because the contract cannot be replaced without the revenue it carries and the buyer discounts that revenue, holds it back in escrow, or makes the consent a condition of closing until it arrives; extinguished by a carve-out at signing that lets the contract pass on a change of control, by structuring the exit so that no assignment occurs, or by the pivot's own indifference, which is common and cannot be counted on; not power-trades' Veto sold as an improbability, where the founder sold the investor a block over named future states and was paid a valuation for it, nor term-sheet-powers' Veto priced by the clock, where the investor bought its block over a sale, since here the customer got its block for nothing, did not ask for it, and learns it holds one from the request; and not Named in the file, where the pivot's name is what cannot be changed, since here the pivot's name is nowhere and its signature is everything.

Sensitized: the dependent party's own history narrows the set of substitutes that can serve it, one exception at a time, until one remains, as the transplant candidate whose prior transfusions and pregnancies have raised antibodies against most donors, the buyer whose ten years of negotiated exceptions mean only one vendor's contract fits its operations, the borrower whose covenants only the incumbent lender will carry, the software estate whose ten years of custom integrations fit one vendor's interface; the dependency created is a compatibility requirement the dependent accreted itself; substitution stops working when the newest exception excludes the last alternative, which the dependent does not notice because each exception was small and won; extinguished by desensitization, a rewrite back to the standard that costs every exception's value at once, by a chain in which the dependent's incompatible match is swapped for another pair's compatible one, as the kidney-exchange chain does, or by a substitute willing to learn the exceptions, which is Learned your dialect begun again; the transplant case is observed and the extension to contracts and covenants is by analogy; not Last one standing, where the field thinned by others' exits, since here the field is full and the dependent cannot use it; and not Head as the only copy, where the state is in the pivot, since here it is in the dependent and the pivot merely fits.

Last signature: a process that needs every party's consent and collects the consents one at a time makes the last unsigned party pivotal, whoever it happens to be, as the last parcel in a land assembly, the last creditor in a restructuring without a collective-action clause, the last co-owner of the house, the last state whose ratification brings a treaty into force, the last founder's signature on a round that requires unanimity; the dependency created is a consent that has become the whole deal's condition, since every earlier signature is worthless without it; substitution stops working the moment the count of unsigned parties drops to what the rule requires, one, or the number that completes a threshold, and it never worked for that party's consent in particular but did work for its place, since any of the many could have been last; extinguished by a simultaneous closing in which every signature is held in escrow and released at once so that nobody is last, by a collective-action clause, a drag-along, or a cram-down that lets a majority bind the rest, or by compulsory purchase; not power-trades' Kingmaker's tax, where pivotality is the arithmetic of seats and is traded for ministries, since here it is manufactured by the order of signing and would not exist at a table that closed at once; and not deal-deaths' Signer with no upside, a consent held by someone who gains nothing, since here the signer wanted the deal and is made pivotal by having waited.

Anchor conditioned on: one party becomes pivotal because every other party's commitment was written as conditional on it, as the lead investor the syndicate's cheques are contingent on, the anchor tenant every co-tenancy clause in the mall refers to, the agent bank the loan syndicate follows, the named principal investigator on a grant, the keynote the other speakers accepted on the strength of; the dependency created is a condition precedent in other people's paper; substitution stops working at the first follower who conditions, since from then on the anchor's withdrawal is not one party lost but all of them, and the anchor learns this at the same moment the followers do; extinguished by closing, which converts every condition into a wire, by a substitute anchor the followers will accept on the same paper, which is rare since the followers were following the name, or by a rule that fixes the followers' commitments to the terms and not to the lead; not Last signature, where the pivot is whoever came last, since here the pivot may have come first and is pivotal because the others tied themselves to it; and not deal-deaths' Champion's single-tender want, where one organization's wanting is held in one sponsor, since here many parties' wanting is held in one outsider.

Last one standing: the field of substitutes thins by exits that have nothing to do with this process, until the party that remains is pivotal without having done anything, as the last qualified supplier of a component after the others left the line, the last pharmacy that compounds the drug, the last living witness, the last foundry running the old process node, the last firm that still maintains the language the system was written in; the dependency created is the remainder of a market; substitution stops working when the second-to-last exits, which is usually unannounced and often unnoticed by the buyer, whose approved-vendor list still shows five names; extinguished by a lifetime buy that stocks the part for the platform's remaining life, by a redesign that removes the part, by an emulation, or by the platform's own retirement, and the extinguisher's cost rises with every year the attrition went unwatched; a buyer that conceals its sole-source position from the survivor, keeping requests for quotation going to firms that cannot supply, is running walkaway-manufactures' Fed suitor or Qualified on paper against its own pivot, and the concealment holds until the survivor's other customers tell it what it is; not market-deaths' Witness starving, where a benchmark's flow thins to one cargo, since here the thing is still made and traded, and what dies is the buyer's ability to leave.

Inside the lead time: the time left in the process falls below every substitute's lead time, so the incumbent is pivotal by the calendar alone, as the carrier whose truck is already on the road when the delivery window narrows to a day, the crew that is on site when the harvest is ready, the counsel who holds the brief the week before trial, the fund that has done its diligence when the company has six weeks of cash, the winning bidder after the award when a re-tender would take the whole cycle again; the dependency created is presence inside a window nobody else can reach; substitution stops working at the crossing of two curves, the remaining time falling and the shortest substitute's lead time, and any party that can read both curves can name the day, which is why the union times its strike to the harvest and the port its demands to the peak season; extinguished by the deadline passing, since the power dies with the window it was minted in whether the process finished or failed, by slack restored, a deadline moved, a bridge bought, or by a runner-up held at its bid for the length of the window; adjacent to lead-time-floors' Rising floor, where the lead time lengthens as the runway shortens, since that item reads the dependent party's death line and this one reads what the same clock mints in the hand of whoever is already inside it.

Float gone to zero: a task that had slack becomes the task the whole project waits on, and its party becomes pivotal, because other tasks finished early or slipped and the critical path moved onto it, as the subcontractor whose ductwork was never on the critical path until the steel came in a month early, the localization vendor whose two weeks became the release's last two weeks, the regulator whose review ran in parallel until everything else was done; the dependency created is a position on the schedule's longest chain, a property of the network and not of the party; substitution stops working when the task's float reaches zero against an end date that cannot move, a season, a launch slot, a liquidated-damages date, since from then on every day spent substituting is a day past the end, and the substitution is itself a task on the critical path; where the end date is soft the same zero float is a delay and not a mint, which is the line this map draws between costly and impossible; extinguished by the task's completion, which moves the path elsewhere and mints the next party, by re-sequencing that restores float, or by accepting the delay, and a project manager who reads the float report sees the mint a week before the party feels it; not Inside the lead time, where the clock runs out on the whole process, since here the process may have months left and the pivot is made by the shape of what remains; and not lead-time-floors' Chain's longest link, where a replacement waits on other people's replacements, since here nothing is being replaced and the chain is the work itself.

Voice they will answer: the counterparty's trust attaches to the individual who has carried the process and not to the firm behind them, so the individual becomes pivotal to closing, as the salesperson whose book of business walks with them, the banker the seller will take calls from, the hostage negotiator the kidnappers will speak to and no one else, the diplomat the other side's minister has met four times; the dependency created is a relationship the counterparty will not transfer; substitution stops working when the counterparty declines to speak to anyone else, and it is the counterparty and not the process that fixes that moment, so the mint is made in another party's head and the firm learns of it last; extinguished by closing, by a second voice introduced early and kept on every call, which is why negotiating teams rotate the primary and why a client with two contacts at a firm survives a partner's leaving, or by the counterparty's own turnover; not status-conversions' Furniture's ear or Introducer's tab, which convert standing into access and credit, since here nothing converts and the person is pivotal only inside this process and to this counterparty; and adjacent to Head as the only copy, a record that could be written, since a relationship cannot be written down and can only be duplicated.

Switch that reads as a tell: the process enters a phase watched by a third party who reads any change of party as a defect in the process, so the incumbent becomes pivotal not because it cannot be replaced but because replacing it would be read, as the auditor in the two years before a listing, whose change must be disclosed in the prospectus, the lead counsel in the middle of a deal, the lead bank before pricing, the chief financial officer before the roadshow, the general contractor while the lender is drawing the loan; the dependency created is the watcher's inference; substitution stops working when the watcher begins watching, which is earlier than the dependent expects since the prospectus reaches back two years, and starts working again when the phase ends; extinguished by the phase ending, by a change announced and explained before the watching begins, a planned rotation on the record, or by the watcher's own rule that names ordinary reasons for a switch; adjacent to lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, where the source sees the search, since here a third party sees the switch and the dependent's commonest cure elsewhere on this map, moving work to a second party, is itself the tell; and this is the one mint in which the pivot is replaceable and the dependent may not replace it.

Appearance entered: the same rule that makes the party pivotal forbids it to price the pivotality, as the attorney of record who cannot withdraw near trial without the court's leave, the physician who cannot abandon a patient mid-course, the officer who cannot resign in the field, and the general contractor whose surety must finish if it walks, which is the same leash bought as a bond rather than imposed as a duty; the dependency created is a duty attached at the moment of indispensability, so the power is minted and extinguished in one motion; substitution stops working when the rule's trigger is crossed, the appearance entered, the treatment begun, the command taken, and from then on the pivot is the one party that cannot leave; extinguished before it is born, by the duty, and the duty itself lapses only when a substitute is in place, which is why the court grants leave once new counsel has appeared and the physician may withdraw once the patient is transferred; not tollgates-that-must-buy's Answer that may not be withheld or Hour that must be manned, where the court must decide and the licensed gate must staff the hour and each buys what its position compels, since here the rule binds the pivot to stay rather than the gate to buy, and the utility with a duty to serve belongs there, having never been replaceable; and an operator reading the rest of this map should ask at every mint whether a duty attaches, since a pivot with a duty is the cheapest pivot to hold.

Discovered by the fire: consolidation several tiers below the dependent party has left one plant or one firm making an input that everyone above it believed came from many, and none of the parties above it knows, nor often the pivot itself, how many of them it is the only source for, until the pivot fails, as the 2012 explosion at one chemical plant in Marl that cut off a large share of the world's nylon-12 for fuel and brake lines, and the 2011 earthquake at one microcontroller plant in Naka that stopped car lines on three continents, simplified to the mechanism; the dependency created is a single point in a chain nobody had drawn; substitution stops working years before anyone looks, at the exit of the second-to-last maker two tiers down, and the power is never exercised because it is never known, so the pivot sells, on this map's conjecture, at a competitive price a thing it alone can supply; extinguished by the failure itself, after which every buyer maps the tier and dual-sources, and the extinguisher costs the whole platform's downtime instead of a lifetime buy, or by a supply-chain map drawn before the fire, which is the only case on this map where the pivot's ignorance of its buyers is the dependent's protection and the dependent's ignorance of its tiers is its exposure; not Last one standing, where the buyer's own approved-vendor list thins in front of it, since here the list is two tiers down and belongs to someone else; and not risk-rebound-effects' mitigations that create a larger risk, since nothing was mitigated and the risk was minted by consolidation nobody chose as a risk.

source.register: Operator-grade and concrete: liability seams, yield curves, arbitrator replacement rules, takeoff decision speeds, moulds and master tapes and source-code escrow, marketing authorizations and engineers of record, anti-assignment clauses, transplant sensitization, land assemblies and collective-action clauses, syndicate conditions and co-tenancy clauses, approved-vendor lists and lifetime buys, delivery windows and harvests, critical-path float, books of business and hostage-negotiation rotas, auditor changes before a listing, attorneys of record, a nylon-12 plant fire; drawn from construction, procurement, litigation, arbitration, aviation, surgery, pharmaceuticals, venture and loan syndicates, treaties, logistics, project scheduling, sales, diplomacy, and tiered supply chains.
source.mode: Analytical distinctions with observed illustrative cases, each simplified to one mechanism. Sensitized carries a transplant case that is observed and an extension to contracts and covenants that is by analogy, and says so. Discovered by the fire rests on two documented single-point failures, the 2012 Marl plant explosion and the 2011 Naka plant earthquake, simplified to the mechanism and not to the exact share of supply lost; the plants knew their shares, what nobody above them knew was the convergence, and the claim that such a pivot sells at a competitive price is conjecture and the item says so. Float gone to zero is a claim about the critical path's arithmetic, and its extension from schedules to parties is analytical. The arbitrator replacement rule in Head as the only copy describes the common shape of institutional rules, not any one institution's text. No item is invented-world.
boundary_claim: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real project, raise, or trial mints several of these at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every kind of hold-up.

The seriation is an itinerary of who mints the pivotality, not a ranking of strength or of how much the pivot can extract; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, loop, incompatibility, dependency, and passage they draw are interpretations.

The unit is the transition into pivotality, not a catalog of gatekeepers: a party that was the only source from the start is out, and a party that is merely more expensive to replace is in only where the replacement's cost or time exceeds what remains of the process, which is the threshold each item names.

The illustrative cases (arbitrator replacement, source-code escrow, marketing-authorization variations, transplant sensitization, land assemblies, co-tenancy clauses, lifetime buys, prospectus disclosure of auditor changes, the Marl and Naka failures) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about specific transactions or about what the law requires in any one jurisdiction.

power-trades' Key man's lever and Kingmaker's tax hold pivotality traded on paper and pivotality set by the arithmetic of seats; tollgates-that-must-buy holds what a gate is compelled to buy; lead-time-floors holds how long a replacement takes; who-can-be-bound holds what makes a party bindable. This map takes only the moment a replaceable party stops being replaceable inside a running process and what ends the power, and where an item touches one of those lists it says what it adds.

seriation.axis: Who mints the pivotality: from pivotality the incumbent makes with its own hands, head, or custody, through pivotality made by the work's own phases, by the dependent party's own paper and history, by the other parties' signing, conditioning, and leaving, by the clock and the schedule with no hand at all, by the counterparty's head, by a watcher who reads switches, by a rule that mints the power and binds it in one motion, to pivotality that no party made, knew, or priced until it failed.
seriation.note: An authored walk, not a scale of strength. Poured foundation opens it because the incumbent minted its pivotality with its own hands and can price it at the next phase; Discovered by the fire closes it because nobody minted it, nobody knew, and the price was never paid until the plant burned. Learned your dialect → Head as the only copy is the first consequential adjacency: both mints live in the incumbent, but one could be written down and has not been, so its extinguisher is a document and its tell is the pivot's resistance to writing, while the other cannot be written and its extinguisher is a second ramp paid for throughout. Head as the only copy → Held on their floor → Past V1 closes the incumbent's three mints, hands, head, and custody, before the walk leaves the incumbent for the work's own phases; Held on their floor stands ahead of Past V1 because custody is still something the incumbent holds, while the unpausable phase is minted by the work, and on the critic's reading this keeps the itinerary in the order the axis sentence names. Named in the file → Consent that wakes at the exit → Sensitized walks the dependent party's own contribution: it writes the pivot's name into a third party's file, the manufacturing site into the authorization and the engineer of record onto the drawings, it writes the pivot a veto it does not know it holds, and it narrows its own compatibility one exception at a time, so the three are three ways the dependent makes its own hostage-taker and the cure for each is on the dependent's side. Last signature → Anchor conditioned on is the hinge among the mints made by others: one is whoever came last and one may be whoever came first, and the escrow closing that cures the first is no cure for the second. Inside the lead time → Float gone to zero separates the clock of the whole process from the shape of what remains of it. Switch that reads as a tell → Appearance entered → Discovered by the fire is the end of the walk, where the question stops being who mints and becomes who may price: the watcher forbids the dependent to replace a replaceable pivot, the rule forbids the pivot to price an irreplaceable one, and the fire reveals a pivot that nobody priced because nobody knew; the last stop is placed by the absence of any minting hand, which is the axis run out.

relations.label: If the anchor has committed, the followers' consents are collected one at a time, and the closing needs all of them or a minimum the last cheque completes, the closing runs down to a last follower who can now hold the anchor's whole syndicate, so the party that conditioned on the anchor inherits the anchor's pivotality by arriving last; where the round can close short or the allocation can be filled from outside, the last follower holds nothing, and a simultaneous closing that cures the last signature cures the anchor only if the anchor's own wire sits in the same escrow.

relations.label: If the earlier signers' commitments carry a release, a long-stop date or a condition that their consent lapses unless the last party signs by it, the last signer's refusal does not hold them but frees them, which is the anchor's shape, every other commitment conditioned on one party, so the loop closes and what the last signer holds is capped at the deal's value to itself before the date; where the earlier signatures are unconditional and undated, nobody has conditioned on the last signer's name, it holds everyone by place alone, the loop does not close, and arriving late on purpose buys the holdout and not the anchor's position.

relations.to: Voice they will answer: the counterparty's trust attaches to the individual who has carried the process and not to the firm behind them, so the individual becomes pivotal to closing, as the salesperson whose book of business walks with them, the banker the seller will take calls from, the hostage negotiator the kidnappers will speak to and no one else, the diplomat the other side's minister has met four times; the dependency created is a relationship the counterparty will not transfer; substitution stops working when the counterparty declines to speak to anyone else, and it is the counterparty and not the process that fixes that moment, so the mint is made in another party's head and the firm learns of it last; extinguished by closing, by a second voice introduced early and kept on every call, which is why negotiating teams rotate the primary and why a client with two contacts at a firm survives a partner's leaving, or by the counterparty's own turnover; not status-conversions' Furniture's ear or Introducer's tab, which convert standing into access and credit, since here nothing converts and the person is pivotal only inside this process and to this counterparty; and adjacent to Head as the only copy, a record that could be written, since a relationship cannot be written down and can only be duplicated.
relations.label: If the followers conditioned on a named person at the anchor rather than on the anchor's institution, as a syndicate that follows a partner and not a fund, the anchor's pivotality passes down a level to that person, who can carry it out the door, and power-trades' Key man's lever is the paper that prices exactly this passage; where the followers conditioned on the institution, the person is replaceable inside it and the anchor's pivotality stays at the level of the firm.

relations.from: Learned your dialect: the incumbent's skill at this customer's particular work is made by the work itself and can be neither written down nor bought elsewhere, as the supplier whose line runs the part at ninety-eight percent yield after a year while a second source would start at sixty, the paralegal who knows this judge's clerk, the nurse who knows this patient's veins; the dependency created is a yield that exists only in the incumbent; substitution stops working when a substitute's ramp, the scrap and the months at low yield, costs more than what remains of the contract, so the same incumbent is replaceable in year one of a five-year contract and pivotal in year four; extinguished by a second source qualified with a real share of the volume while the first still runs, a tax paid throughout as the price of the pivotality never being minted, or by a design change that sets everyone's yield to zero at once; not Head as the only copy, whose state could be written down and has not been, since here no write-down exists and the extinguisher is a second ramp rather than a document; adjacent to lead-time-floors' Ramp inside the floor, which is the replacement's ramp read as a lead time, since here the ramp the incumbent has already run is what mints it.
relations.to: Switch that reads as a tell: the process enters a phase watched by a third party who reads any change of party as a defect in the process, so the incumbent becomes pivotal not because it cannot be replaced but because replacing it would be read, as the auditor in the two years before a listing, whose change must be disclosed in the prospectus, the lead counsel in the middle of a deal, the lead bank before pricing, the chief financial officer before the roadshow, the general contractor while the lender is drawing the loan; the dependency created is the watcher's inference; substitution stops working when the watcher begins watching, which is earlier than the dependent expects since the prospectus reaches back two years, and starts working again when the phase ends; extinguished by the phase ending, by a change announced and explained before the watching begins, a planned rotation on the record, or by the watcher's own rule that names ordinary reasons for a switch; adjacent to lead-time-floors' Seeking is telling, where the source sees the search, since here a third party sees the switch and the dependent's commonest cure elsewhere on this map, moving work to a second party, is itself the tell; and this is the one mint in which the pivot is replaceable and the dependent may not replace it.
relations.label: If the process has entered a watched phase and the learned yield's only extinguisher, a second source run on a real share of the volume, requires a visible transfer of work away from the incumbent inside the window, as moving a lead counsel's brief mid-deal or a general contractor's scope while the lender is drawing, the transfer is the tell the watcher reads as a defect in the first, so the cure is unavailable exactly when the mint bites; where the second source can be added without the incumbent's share visibly falling, or the watcher reads dual-sourcing as prudence, as a prospectus reader does with a supplier, both stand and the dual-source tax works.

relations.from: Sensitized: the dependent party's own history narrows the set of substitutes that can serve it, one exception at a time, until one remains, as the transplant candidate whose prior transfusions and pregnancies have raised antibodies against most donors, the buyer whose ten years of negotiated exceptions mean only one vendor's contract fits its operations, the borrower whose covenants only the incumbent lender will carry, the software estate whose ten years of custom integrations fit one vendor's interface; the dependency created is a compatibility requirement the dependent accreted itself; substitution stops working when the newest exception excludes the last alternative, which the dependent does not notice because each exception was small and won; extinguished by desensitization, a rewrite back to the standard that costs every exception's value at once, by a chain in which the dependent's incompatible match is swapped for another pair's compatible one, as the kidney-exchange chain does, or by a substitute willing to learn the exceptions, which is Learned your dialect begun again; the transplant case is observed and the extension to contracts and covenants is by analogy; not Last one standing, where the field thinned by others' exits, since here the field is full and the dependent cannot use it; and not Head as the only copy, where the state is in the pivot, since here it is in the dependent and the pivot merely fits.
relations.to: Last one standing: the field of substitutes thins by exits that have nothing to do with this process, until the party that remains is pivotal without having done anything, as the last qualified supplier of a component after the others left the line, the last pharmacy that compounds the drug, the last living witness, the last foundry running the old process node, the last firm that still maintains the language the system was written in; the dependency created is the remainder of a market; substitution stops working when the second-to-last exits, which is usually unannounced and often unnoticed by the buyer, whose approved-vendor list still shows five names; extinguished by a lifetime buy that stocks the part for the platform's remaining life, by a redesign that removes the part, by an emulation, or by the platform's own retirement, and the extinguisher's cost rises with every year the attrition went unwatched; a buyer that conceals its sole-source position from the survivor, keeping requests for quotation going to firms that cannot supply, is running walkaway-manufactures' Fed suitor or Qualified on paper against its own pivot, and the concealment holds until the survivor's other customers tell it what it is; not market-deaths' Witness starving, where a benchmark's flow thins to one cargo, since here the thing is still made and traded, and what dies is the buyer's ability to leave.
relations.label: If the dependent party's own exceptions have excluded every substitute but one, the state looks from the outside like a field thinned by attrition and the dependent blames the market, while the cure is on its own side, a rewrite back to the standard, and a buyer that answers a sensitized position with a lifetime buy or a search for new suppliers has bought the wrong extinguisher; where the field really has thinned, the search is right and the rewrite changes nothing.

relations.label: If the second-to-last exit happens on a list the buyer does not keep, two tiers down in a supplier's supplier, the same attrition that mints a priced pivot on the buyer's own list mints an unpriced one nobody can see, and the power that would have been paid at the next negotiation is paid instead in the downtime after the failure; where the buyer keeps the list live to the tier where consolidation happens, the mint stays on this side of the fork and is priced while there is still time to buy the lifetime stock.

relations.from: Past V1: the process enters a phase that cannot be held still while a replacement arrives, so whoever is on the controls at that instant, together with anyone already following the live state beside them, are the only parties who can finish, as the captain past the takeoff decision speed, the anaesthetist after induction, the crane operator with the load off the deck, the tug master inside the lock, the negotiator on the line with the man holding the hostages, the founder in the closing week whose every counterparty has one number in one head; the dependency created is continuity of a state nobody outside the loop can take up in motion; substitution stops working at the instant the phase begins, which is usually a named line, V1, the first incision, the load leaving the deck, and works again at the next stable state, the aircraft at altitude on the autopilot, the patient closed, the load on the ground; extinguished by that next stable state, by a second already in the loop who can take the controls inside the phase, which is what the co-pilot's incapacitation drill, the relief anaesthetist in the room, and the negotiator's second listening on the line are for, by a protocol that makes stable states frequent and the handover at each rehearsed, which is what the shift handover in intensive care and the negotiating team's rota are for, or by the process ending; distinct from lead-time-floors' Understudy, a spare finished and waiting, since a spare that has not been following the state is no use inside the phase, and this map's question is at which instants, and by whom, the spare can be swapped in.
relations.to: Appearance entered: the same rule that makes the party pivotal forbids it to price the pivotality, as the attorney of record who cannot withdraw near trial without the court's leave, the physician who cannot abandon a patient mid-course, the officer who cannot resign in the field, and the general contractor whose surety must finish if it walks, which is the same leash bought as a bond rather than imposed as a duty; the dependency created is a duty attached at the moment of indispensability, so the power is minted and extinguished in one motion; substitution stops working when the rule's trigger is crossed, the appearance entered, the treatment begun, the command taken, and from then on the pivot is the one party that cannot leave; extinguished before it is born, by the duty, and the duty itself lapses only when a substitute is in place, which is why the court grants leave once new counsel has appeared and the physician may withdraw once the patient is transferred; not tollgates-that-must-buy's Answer that may not be withheld or Hour that must be manned, where the court must decide and the licensed gate must staff the hour and each buys what its position compels, since here the rule binds the pivot to stay rather than the gate to buy, and the utility with a duty to serve belongs there, having never been replaceable; and an operator reading the rest of this map should ask at every mint whether a duty attaches, since a pivot with a duty is the cheapest pivot to hold.
relations.label: If the phase that cannot be paused is one the law has already named, a duty attaches at the same line, so the captain past the decision speed and the surgeon past the incision are pivotal and bound in one motion and cannot price the phase; where the phase is new to the law, the founder in the closing week or the engineer in the cutover night, the pivot may price it, and the dependent party's only cure is to reach the next stable state before the price is named.

exploration.first_question: By what mechanisms does a process that begins with a replaceable party end with that party indispensable to its completion, at what moment does substitution stop working, and what ends the power once it is minted?
exploration.changed_question: Who does the minting and who knows it has happened: breath one wrote every mint as something the incumbent did or held, its hands, its head, its custody, its place in the sequence, and assumed the incumbent could price it at the next negotiation. Pressing on Last one standing produced a pivot the buyer cannot see because the attrition is on a list it does not keep; pressing on Appearance entered produced a pivot that may not price what it holds; pressing on Named in the file showed the dependent party writing its own hostage-takers into the paper at entry. So the question became who mints it, the incumbent, the dependent, the other parties, the clock, a watcher, a rule, or nobody, and whether the power needs anyone's knowledge to exist, which the first framing could not ask because it assumed a pivot knows it is one.

priorities.why: Its carrier is public: a registration statement must disclose a change of auditor within the prior two fiscal years and the reasons for it, so whether a switch inside the watched phase is read as a defect can be checked from filings without anyone's cooperation.
priorities.next_question: Take every initial public offering filed over a decade and split the filers by whether the prospectus discloses an auditor change in the two years before filing; compare withdrawal rates, pricing against the stated range, and time from first filing to pricing. If the switchers withdraw more and price lower with the same financials, the watcher reads the switch; if switchers whose change is explained as a planned rotation do as well as non-switchers, the extinguisher named here works and can be bought before the phase.

priorities.why: Low confidence in the strong form, that most pivotality in tiered supply is unknown to every party including the pivot and so is never priced, since every visible case is by construction one that failed; high generative promise, because if it holds, the market price of hold-up is a small fraction of its incidence and the survivor sells its sole supply at a competitive price for years, which would mean the map's last stop is its commonest one.
priorities.next_question: Take the inputs whose sole-source position was revealed by a documented failure and match each to inputs of the same measured concentration two tiers down that did not fail; count how many tier-one buyers of each dual-sourced within two years and what the survivor's price did before and after. If the survivor's price rose only after the failure and the unfailed matches never dual-sourced, pivotality was minted and unpriced on both sides; then ask whether a map drawn before the fire, the extinguisher named here, was ever bought by anyone who had not already been burned.

gate.independent_review: Fable critic: admitted after repairing eight items and three edge labels, chiefly Past V1's false claim that a spare beside the controls is no use inside the phase, the auditor misfiled under Named in the file, the never-replaceable utility under Appearance entered, and the anchor-last-signer loop and dialect-tell incompatibility narrowed to the antecedents under which they hold; Held on their floor moved ahead of Past V1 to match the axis; no item restates power-trades or tollgates-that-must-buy.

neighbors.left: Learned your dialect: the incumbent's skill at this customer's particular work is made by the work itself and can be neither written down nor bought elsewhere, as the supplier whose line runs the part at ninety-eight percent yield after a year while a second source would start at sixty, the paralegal who knows this judge's clerk, the nurse who knows this patient's veins; the dependency created is a yield that exists only in the incumbent; substitution stops working when a substitute's ramp, the scrap and the months at low yield, costs more than what remains of the contract, so the same incumbent is replaceable in year one of a five-year contract and pivotal in year four; extinguished by a second source qualified with a real share of the volume while the first still runs, a tax paid throughout as the price of the pivotality never being minted, or by a design change that sets everyone's yield to zero at once; not Head as the only copy, whose state could be written down and has not been, since here no write-down exists and the extinguisher is a second ramp rather than a document; adjacent to lead-time-floors' Ramp inside the floor, which is the replacement's ramp read as a lead time, since here the ramp the incumbent has already run is what mints it.
neighbors.right: Head as the only copy: the process writes its state into one participant faster than it writes it down, as the engineer who knows why the configuration is the way it is, the case manager who has met every witness, the arbitrator who has heard the evidence and watched the witnesses' faces, so the record of the process lives in a head and a substitute cannot resume, only restart; the dependency created is unrecorded state; substitution stops working when the gap between what the head knows and what the file says exceeds what a replacement could recover in the time the process has left, which is why an arbitrator can be replaced after a week of hearings and not after a year, and why most institutional rules let the reconstituted tribunal decide whether the hearings must be repeated; extinguished by the write-down, the handover file, the second engineer who must be able to run it alone for a week, which the pivot resists in proportion to the power it would lose, or by completion; adjacent to status-conversions' Immunity by entanglement, where seniority becomes immunity because the institution's memory runs through one person, since that item reads the conversion of standing and this one the date on the calendar after which the person could no longer be replaced; and adjacent to market-deaths' Wall in one head, where a market's comparison wall is one broker's memory, since here the head sits inside a process still running and can still be copied out.
neighbors.separating_case: Two people at the same supplier give a month's notice on the same day: the process engineer who knows why every setting on the line is what it is, and the operator whose hands hold the yield. The buyer pays for a handover from each. The engineer produces a document and the successor runs the line from it by the end of the month, so the buyer's replaceability was recoverable for the price of the write-down and the month. The operator produces nothing usable and the successor's yield falls to sixty percent for two quarters, so the only thing that would have kept the buyer replaceable was a second operator run on a share of the volume a year earlier. Both were pivotal on the day the notices arrived; one pivotality was a debt the buyer could still pay off and the other was a ramp it had to have started, which is why the items differ in their extinguisher and not only in what the pivot holds.

checks.boundary_case: The only port on the coast, the one maker of a machine nobody else can build, the sovereign that alone can grant the licence, are tempting nonmembers and are out: they were never replaceable, so no process minted their position and there is no moment at which substitution stopped working. The map's fence is the transition, a party that was one of several at entry and is the only one at some later point inside the same process. A second tempting nonmember is the party that is merely more expensive to replace, the senior engineer with a long ramp; it is in only where the replacement's cost or time exceeds what remains of the process, which is the threshold each item names, so the same engineer is out in year one of a five-year contract and in during year four, and a critic who wants a clean line between costly and impossible will not find one here because hold-up does not have one.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: from Anchor conditioned on, the followers' condition names either an institution or a person, and by the first road, where the closing needs every follower or a minimum the last cheque completes, the anchor's pivotality flows into Last signature as the consents are collected one at a time, while by the second it passes down a level into Voice they will answer and walks out of the firm with the partner, which is the passage power-trades' Key man's lever prices. It shows a loop, Anchor conditioned on → Last signature → Anchor conditioned on, that closes only under a stated antecedent: the anchor's commitment lets the followers sign, the sequence of their signing mints a last signer, and where the earlier signers' commitments carry a release, a long-stop date or a lapse unless the last party signs by it, the last signer's refusal frees everyone rather than holding them, which is the anchor's shape, so the loop closes and what the last signer holds is capped at the deal's value to itself before the date; where the earlier signatures are unconditional and undated, nobody has conditioned on the last signer's name, it holds everyone by place alone, the loop does not close, and arriving late on purpose buys the holdout and not the anchor's position; the escrow closing breaks the first road only if the anchor's own wire is inside it. It shows a conditional incompatibility between Learned your dialect and Switch that reads as a tell: the only extinguisher of a learned yield is a second source run on real volume, and where the process is in a watched phase and that second source requires a visible transfer of work away from the incumbent inside the window, the transfer is the tell, so the cure is unavailable exactly when the mint bites; where the second source can be added without the incumbent's share visibly falling, or the watcher reads dual-sourcing as prudence, as a prospectus reader does with a supplier, both stand and the dual-source tax works. It shows a dependency at Sensitized → Last one standing, where the same visible state, one substitute left, has its cure on the dependent's side in one case and on the market's in the other, so a buyer that reads a sensitized position as attrition buys the wrong extinguisher. And it shows the map's second fork at Last one standing → Discovered by the fire, which is one mechanism, the second-to-last exit, split by whether the list it happens on is one the buyer keeps, with the priced pivot on one side and, on the other, one that nobody above the pivot can see and that the pivot itself cannot count; the edge Past V1 → Appearance entered is a dependency between the phase and the duty, since the law attaches the leash only to phases it has already named, which tells an operator that a new kind of unpausable phase is a priced pivot until the law catches up.
checks.target_preserved: Fable critic (fresh context, 2026-09-10) judged the target preserved: every item names a distinct mint, the dependency it creates, the moment substitution stops working, and what extinguishes the power; no item restates power-trades or tollgates-that-must-buy; the strange members (a pivot that may not price what it holds, a replaceable pivot the dependent may not replace, a veto the pivot did not know it held, a pivotality nobody above the pivot priced until the plant burned, a pivot made by the schedule's shape) survived the critic's collapse attempts (Past V1 into Inside the lead time, Last signature into Kingmaker's tax) and were repaired as mechanisms, not softened into advice about dual-sourcing.
